title: Settings
subtitle: Connect your music accounts to fetch private playlists and create Apple Music playlists.

qq.name: QQ Music
qq.description: Log in to access private playlists on y.qq.com.

netease.name: NetEase Cloud Music
netease.description: Log in to access private playlists on music.163.com.

apple.name: Apple Music
apple.description: Log in to search, match tracks, and create playlists on music.apple.com.

matching.title: Matching
matching.description: When you run a match, nq2am searches Apple Music for each source track, scores the candidates, and selects the highest-scoring candidate when it reaches the match threshold. Changes apply the next time you run or retry a match.

threshold.label: Match threshold:
threshold.help: Higher is safer but sends more tracks to Not found.
threshold.tooltip: Each candidate receives a score from title, artist, duration, and version hints. If the best score is below this value, it is not auto-selected; the track becomes not found with candidates kept for review.

explicit.label: Explicit / clean preference
explicit.help: Only used to order candidates with equal scores.
explicit.tooltip: This does not filter search results. It only orders otherwise equally scored explicit and clean versions.

storefront.label: Storefront
storefront.help: Leave blank unless your Apple Music account region is detected wrong.
storefront.tooltip: This is the Apple Music account region used when creating the final playlist, such as us, jp, or cn.

matching.preferDuration: Prefer candidates whose duration is closest to the source track
matching.preferDurationTooltip: Adds a small score bonus when the Apple Music duration is close to the source track. The bonus is strongest within about 2 seconds and fades out by about 30 seconds.
matching.preferOriginal: Prefer original studio versions over remaster / live / karaoke
matching.preferOriginalTooltip: Applies a small penalty to candidates whose title looks like remaster, live, karaoke, instrumental, cover, version, or remix, unless the source title also asks for that version.

performance.title: Performance and request pacing
performance.description: These values apply to new matches, retries, cross-region song resolution, and playlist creation.

concurrency.label: Parallel tracks
concurrency.tooltip: Maximum number of source tracks evaluated at once. Higher values can finish faster on a good connection but create more simultaneous work and memory use.

interval.label: Minimum request interval
interval.help: Fixed spacing between Apple request starts.
interval.tooltip: Every Apple API request starts at least this many milliseconds after the previous one. This pacing is shared by all parallel workers in the current job.

requestTimeout.label: Apple request timeout
requestTimeout.help: Applied separately to each request attempt.
requestTimeout.tooltip: A catalog request that takes longer than this is treated as a transient failure and may be retried according to the attempt limit.

maxAttempts.label: Maximum attempts
maxAttempts.tooltip: Total attempts allowed for rate limits, temporary server errors, and network timeouts. For example, 3 means one initial request plus at most two retries.

retryDelay.label: Initial retry delay
retryDelay.tooltip: Base delay for exponential retry backoff. An Apple Retry-After response takes precedence when present.

randomPause.label: Random request pauses
randomPause.help: Adds a variable pause to make request timing less mechanical. It is added after the fixed minimum interval and never overrides Retry-After.
randomPause.tooltip: When enabled, nq2am samples an additional pause from the configured range after every Apple request start. The first request starts immediately.
randomPause.minTooltip: Smallest additional pause that may be added between Apple request starts.
randomPause.maxTooltip: Largest additional pause that may be added between Apple request starts.
randomPause.rangeError: Minimum random pause cannot be greater than maximum random pause. No settings were saved.
